blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dataset distillation (DD) compresses a large training set into a compact synthetic set while preserving downstream training utility. Although DD has been widely studied for images and recently extended to time-series forecasting, its application to human motion prediction remains largely unexplored. Human motion is high-dimensional and structurally coupled, and gradient matching (GM) in the original motion space optimizes many correlated variables without a prior on pose plausibility or temporal dynamics, which frequently yields implausible and unstable synthetic motions. To address this limitation, we propose a latent DD framework that regularizes distillation with a learned motion prior. Motions are first compressed by a residual-quantized variational autoencoder (RVQ-VAE), and distillation then updates only a learnable latent bank through the frozen quantizer and decoder. The pretrained decoder restricts synthetic motions to its output space, while residual quantization progressively refines the latent approximation across multiple codebooks and alleviates the representational bottleneck of single-stage vector quantization. Experiments on Human3.6M, CMU, and 3DPW with two prediction backbones show that the proposed framework outperforms direct GM in 27 of 30 evaluated settings and random subsets in every setting, and produces visibly more plausible synthetic motions in qualitative comparisons.
blocks.zh: 数据集蒸馏(DD)在保留下游培训实用性的同时,将大型培训集压缩成紧凑的合成集. 虽然DD已经为图像进行了广泛的研究,并且最近扩展到时间序列预测,但是它对人类运动预测的应用仍然基本上没有得到探讨. 人类运动是高维的,结构上的结合,在原始运动空间中梯度匹配(GM)可以优化许多互联变量,而事先没有形成合理性或时间动态,这经常产生不可信和不稳定的合成运动. 为了消除这一局限性,我们建议建立一个潜在的DD框架,使蒸馏法与事先学到的动作规范化。 运动首先用残余的量变自编码器(RVQ-VAE)进行压缩,然后蒸馏,然后通过冷冻的整流器和解码器仅更新一个可学习的潜在库. 预调节解码器限制合成运动进入其输出空间,而剩余量化则逐渐完善了跨多个编码簿的潜在近似性,缓解了单级矢量量化的表示瓶颈. 在Human3.6M、CMU和3DPW的实验中,有两个预测主干线,显示拟议框架在30个评估设置和随机子集中,有27个框架的绩效超过直接的全球机制,并在质量比较中产生明显更可信的合成运动。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Dataset distillation (DD) replaces a large training set with a compact synthetic set that preserves downstream training utility [ 21 , 12 ] . Gradient matching (GM) synthesizes such data by aligning the parameter gradients induced by real and synthetic samples [ 27 ] , and later studies improve condensation through differentiable augmentation [ 25 ] , distribution matching [ 26 ] , trajectory matching [ 3 ] , synthetic-data parameterization [ 9 ] , and representative matching [ 14 ] . The resulting synthetic sets have enabled applications such as privacy-preserving medical data sharing [ 11 ] . All of these methods were developed for images, where a synthetic sample is a freely optimized pixel array with a fixed layout.
blocks.zh: 数据集蒸馏(DD)用紧凑的合成集取代大型培训集,保留下游培训的效用[21,12]. 渐变匹配(GM)通过对真样和合成样本所引导的参数梯度进行调和来合成此类数据,后来的研究通过不同的增量[25],分布匹配[26],轨迹匹配[3],合成数据参数化[9],代表性匹配[14]来改进凝聚. 由此产生的合成集使隐私保存医疗数据共享等应用得以实现. [11]. 所有这些方法都是为图像开发的,其中合成样品是具有固定布局的自由优化像素阵列.

blocks.en: DD has recently been extended to temporal data through frequency and trajectory matching [ 18 ] , harmonic matching for forecasting [ 7 ] , and spatio-temporal condensation [ 10 ] . Human motion, however, differs fundamentally from generic time series. Each frame is a pose whose parameters are coupled by the kinematic structure of the body, and motion predictors model the temporal dependencies among these parameters using recurrent [ 17 ] , graph-based [ 15 , 13 ] , attention-based [ 16 , 1 ] , and MLP [ 6 ] architectures. Training such predictors is routinely repeated across architectures and horizons, so a compact synthetic set that retains training utility is of practical interest.
blocks.zh: DD最近通过频率和轨迹匹配[18],调谐匹配预测[7],以及时空缩合[10],扩展到时间数据. 然而,人类运动与通用时间序列有着根本的不同. 每个框架是一个姿势,其参数与身体的运动结构相配合,运动预测器利用经常性的[17],基于图表的[15,13],基于注意力的[16,1],以及MLP[6]架构来模拟这些参数的时间依赖性. 这种预测器的培训通常在各种架构和视野中重复进行,因此,保留培训效用的紧凑合成集具有实际意义。

blocks.en: Despite this potential, applying GM directly to motion data is problematic. Direct GM treats every value of a synthetic sequence as an independent variable and updates it using gradient signals from the predictor alone. For articulated motion, this means searching over many strongly correlated rotation parameters without a prior on which joint configurations and temporal transitions are plausible. Distilled motions then exhibit implausible joint configurations and abrupt transitions, training becomes unstable, and the resulting sets can be inferior even to random subsets.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这种潜力,但将全球机制直接用于数据移动仍有问题。 直接GM将合成序列的每个值作为一个独立的变量处理,并仅使用预测器的梯度信号进行更新. 对于明确提出的动议,这意味着要搜索许多密切相关的旋转参数,而在此之前,联合配置和时间过渡是可行的。 抖动后呈现出难以置信的联合配置和突变,训练变得不稳定,产生的组合甚至可以低于随机子集.

blocks.en:
A natural solution is to regularize distillation with a learned motion prior rather than optimizing freely in the original space. Latent-space DD reduces the optimization burden of synthetic data for images [ 4 ] , and discrete representations learned by VQ-VAE [ 19 ] are effective for motion modeling [ 24 ] . A single codebook, however, imposes a restrictive bottleneck that limits how well a synthetic set adapts to the distillation objective, whereas residual vector quantization (RVQ) represents a latent vector as a sum of codewords drawn progressively from multiple codebooks and relieves this bottleneck while retaining a structured motion prior [ 5 ] .
Building on this observation, we pretrain an RVQ-VAE motion autoencoder and distill in its pre-quantization latent space, updating only a learnable latent bank by GM through the frozen quantizer and decoder, and evaluate the framework on three benchmarks with two prediction backbones.
blocks.zh:
一个自然的解决方案是先用有学识的运动来规范蒸馏,而不是在原始空间自由优化. Lententnt-space DD减轻了图像合成数据的优化负担[4],VQ-VAE所学的离散表示[19]对于运动模型[24]是有效的. 然而,单一的编码簿规定了一个限制性的瓶颈,限制合成器如何适应蒸馏目标,而残留的矢量量化(RVQ)则代表一种潜在的矢量,作为从多个编码簿中逐步抽取的编码词的总和,并缓解了这一瓶颈,同时保留了[5]之前的结构化运动.
基于这一观察,我们预装了一台RVQ-VAE运动自动编码器,并在其预量化潜在空间中蒸馏,仅通过冷冻的整数器和解码器更新全球机制可学习的潜在库,并用两个预测主干线对框架进行三个基准的评估。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下。

blocks.en: • We study dataset distillation for human motion prediction and show that direct GM in the original motion space, lacking a learned motion prior, yields implausible synthetic motions. • We propose a latent distillation framework built on a pretrained RVQ-VAE, in which only a learnable latent bank is optimized by GM through the frozen residual quantizer. • We show empirically that, under a shared objective, distilling in the residual-quantized latent space outperforms direct GM as well as continuous and single-stage latent variants.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们研究用于人类运动预测的数据集蒸馏,并表明在原始运动空间中缺乏事先学会的运动的直接转基因产生不可信的合成运动。 我们建议在经过预先培训的RVQ-VAE基础上建立一个潜在蒸馏框架,其中全球机制通过冷冻的残余四聚体优化一个可学习的潜在库。 我们从经验上表明,在一个共同目标下,在剩余数量化的潜在空间中蒸馏,其表现优于直接的全球机制以及连续和单阶段的潜在变体。

blocks.en: Direct GM optimizes motion features without an explicit structural prior. To regularize the optimization with a learned motion prior, we first train an autoencoder that combines a stochastic VAE encoder with residual vector quantization.

blocks.en: 2.3 Latent Dataset Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.3 底端数据集抖动

blocks.en: The framework that performs distillation over the pretrained latent space is illustrated in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 图1说明了在预先受过训练的潜在空间上进行蒸馏的框架。

blocks.en: Motion-space regularization. At each iteration, a batch of 50-frame real segments is sampled from the full training pool, and synthetic segments are decoded from randomly selected latent slots, so the sequence or action used for initialization does not determine the real–synthetic pairing. blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets and Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate the framework on Human3.6M [ 8 ] , the CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database [ 2 ] , and 3DPW [ 20 ] . Human3.6M is represented by 99-D exponential maps, CMU by 70-D normalized features, and 3DPW by 72-D SMPL axis-angle features. Prediction quality is measured by mean per-joint position error (MPJPE, mm) on 3D joint positions recovered from each representation, where a lower value is better. Models observe 25 frames and predict the next 10; at test time the predicted block is appended to the observation window, and the predictor is reapplied until 25 future frames are produced, so horizons beyond #10 come from rollout. We report frames #2/#4/#8/#10/#14, corresponding to 80/160/320/400/560 ms at 25 fps. Mean5 averages these horizons, and Mean8 adds #18/#22/#25 (720/880/1000 ms).

blocks.en: Baselines and Budgets. We compare Full-data training, Random subset selection, direct GM, and the proposed method. Direct GM optimizes the same initialized segments in the feature space using only the GM objective, with the same budget, backbone, iterations, and learning rate as Ours; the ablation also reports direct GM trained with the objective of Eq. ( 4 ), denoted GM+Reg. The backbone used as the gradient probe is randomly initialized and kept fixed within each run. Adapting temporal DD methods [ 18 , 7 , 10 ] to articulated motion is left for future work. The budget is the number M M of synthetic trajectories, each of which yields 16 overlapping, hence non-independent, 35-frame training windows. The 1 × 1\times / 2 × 2\times / 4 × 4\times budgets correspond to 5%/10%/20% of the real training sequences on Human3.6M, 10%/20%/40% on 3DPW, and 1/2/4 trajectories per action class on CMU, with identical M M for Random, GM, and Ours.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We have presented a latent dataset distillation framework for human motion prediction. Rather than optimizing motion features directly, it distills in the pre-quantization latent space of a pretrained RVQ-VAE and updates only a latent bank through the frozen quantizer and decoder, so gradient matching is regularized by a learned motion prior. On Human3.6M, CMU, and 3DPW with two backbones, the distilled sets outperform direct gradient matching and random subsets under a fixed downstream budget, and residual quantization improves over single-stage quantization among latent variants sharing the same objective. The distilled sets also remain useful when transferred to a backbone other than the one used for distillation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了人类运动预测的潜在数据集蒸馏框架。 它不是直接优化运动特性,而是在预先训练的RVQ-VAE的预量化潜伏空间中蒸馏出来,并且只通过冷冻的整流器和解码器更新潜伏的库,所以梯度匹配通过事先学会的运动来规范化. 在Human3.6M、CMU和具有两根主干线的3DPW上,蒸馏器在固定的下游预算下列出了直接梯度匹配和随机子集,残余的量化在具有相同目标的潜在变种之间的单阶段量化上有所改进。 蒸馏器件在转移到蒸馏器以外的主干器时仍然有用。
